{{Top|leg}}
'''Orbital adjustment jets''' were a type of [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. In conjunction with [[all-axis thruster]]s, orbital adjustment jets were used to stabilize [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] such as [[Exis Station/Legends|Exis Station]] to keep its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] steady.<ref name="Firestorm">{{JournalCite|15|Firestorm (short story)}}</ref>
